name: Article 1, § 1, point 1, point b; Regulation (EU) 2021/1058; Article 3, after § 1b
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council RESTORE – Regional Emergency Support to Reconstruction amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1058 and Regulation (EU) 2021/1057
part_text: 1ba. The ERDF resources used for the purposes of this regulation should subsequently be offset by means of transfers of equal amounts from titles 12, security, and 13, defence, of the EU budget.
